inputs.model.prompt:
Epic cinematic hard sci-fi one-take shot, 5-second sequence, based on the reference scene.

Lone astronaut stands on a rocky cliff edge beside a colossal alien ring megastructure. Twin suns glow in the distant sky, creating dramatic golden god rays through thick atmospheric mist.

The astronaut slowly moves forward toward the massive ring structure. Camera follows with a smooth low-angle dolly push-in, maintaining epic scale and weight.

The giant segmented ring begins to revolve slowly around its central axis. Hexagonal metal panels shift incrementally, and orange glowing circuit lines pulse along the ring frame.

The astronaut passes through the ring-shaped space. The camera gradually reveals a breathtakingly vast cosmic megastructure extending into deep space.

Massive orbital frameworks, distant mechanical spires, floating dust particles, volumetric mist, and dramatic god rays create an overwhelming sense of scale.

Slow smooth motion, IMAX 35mm anamorphic film look, deep depth of field, hyperrealistic, subtle film grain, dramatic twilight lighting.

No fast movement, no jerky camera, no scene cuts, no distorted structures, no deformed astronaut.
